experiment.name: initialisation
experiment.setup: random-seed 1711 setup if count turtles != nb-tortues [ error "effectif" ] if any? turtles with [xcor != x-nid or ycor != y-nid] [error "nid"] if any? turtles with [energie < 1 or energie > energie-max or energie != floor energie] [error "energie initiale"] if ticks != 0 [error "ticks initiaux"]

experiment.name: deplacement-energie
experiment.go: let avant count turtles ask turtles [ let x-avant xcor let y-avant ycor let e-avant energie deplacer-et-consommer let cout e-avant - energie let trajet distancexy x-avant y-avant if cout < 0 or cout > vitesse-max * energie-par-case [error "borne energie"] if abs (cout - trajet * energie-par-case) > 0.0000001 [error "distance et cout"] if trajet > vitesse-max + 0.0000001 [error "vitesse"] ] tick if count turtles > avant [error "population croissante"]

experiment.name: mort
experiment.go: go if any? turtles [error "mort"] if ticks != 1 [error "tick mort"]

experiment.name: extinction
experiment.go: let avant count turtles go if count turtles > avant [error "population croissante"]

experiment.name: dernier-pas-et-bord
experiment.setup: setup clear-turtles create-turtles 1 [setxy max-pxcor 0 set heading 90 set energie 10 forward 2 if abs (xcor - (min-pxcor + 1)) > 0.0000001 [error "raccord bord"]] ask turtles [set energie 0.5] random-seed 1711
